subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family fallback contract for text model failover, and if so should it be wildcard/auto refs, grouped `fallbackFamilies`, catalog-derived fallbacks, or a narrower combination?
rationale: The request would add public provider/model routing and config semantics; repository policy treats fallback behavior and config surface changes as compatibility-sensitive product decisions, not a narrow repair.

options.title: Define one core fallback contract
options.body: Adopt a single documented core shape and implement it consistently across schema, normalization, runtime fallback, docs, and tests before accepting implementation PRs.

options.title: Keep explicit flat fallbacks only
options.body: Reject wildcard/grouped fallback semantics for now and direct users to maintain explicit `agents.defaults.model.fallbacks` lists.

options.title: Land only catalog-derived fallback work
options.body: Treat the narrower `fallbacksFromModels` idea as separate work while leaving wildcard/auto and `fallbackFamilies` unresolved here.

recommendation.title: Define one core fallback contract
recommendation.body: Adopt a single documented core shape and implement it consistently across schema, normalization, runtime fallback, docs, and tests before accepting implementation PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass points to steipete as the strongest owner for the central fallback/config contract and product-scope routing decision.
